identificationModule.briefTitle: Comparison Of Rituximab Versus Tositumomab and Iodine I 131 Tositumomab (BEXXAR® Therapeutic Regimen) For Patients With Relapsed Follicular Non-Hodgkins Lymphoma
identificationModule.officialTitle: A Multi-Center, Randomized, Phase 3 Study of Rituximab Versus Iodine I 131 Tositumomab Therapeutic Regimen For Patients With Relapsed Follicular Non-Hodgkins Lymphoma

armGroups.label: Tositumomab and Iodine I 131 Tositumomab
armGroups.description:
Dosimetric dose: 450 mg Tositumomab infused over 1 hour followed by 5 mCi I 131 Tositumomab infused over 20 minutes

Therapeutic dose: 450 mg Tositumomab infused over 1 hour followed by Individualized mCi activity of I 131 Tositumomab (35 mg) infused over 20 minutes.
interventionNames: Biological: Tositumomab and Iodine I 131 Tositumomab

armGroups.label: Rituximab
armGroups.description: Rituximab 375 mg/m2 given as an IV infusion once weekly for four weeks.
